description.value: McDonald's at 1701 Robson Street sits in the heart of Vancouver's busy Robson Street corridor, one of the city's most prominent tourist and cycling routes through the West End. This location features both indoor and outdoor seating and a full fast-food menu including McCafé beverages, with multiple ordering modes including Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery. Its central urban location makes it a recognizable and accessible refueling point for cyclists moving through downtown Vancouver.
